about: The offices a town has one holder of, for `kyrie lint --world` (src/cli/office-lint.ts): someone titled with one ("Reeve Annis Talfryn"), whose role begins with one ("the reeve of Iscoed", "reeve of the wood-wardens") or whose id ends in one (s2_reeve) holds it in the town they stand in; two in one town are a warning. Each says what the office is, as the warning tells it.

offices.reeve: a town has one of, to answer for it to its lord
offices.portreeve: a port has one of, to answer for it to its lord
offices.headman: a village has one of, to speak for it
offices.headwoman: a village has one of, to speak for it
offices.mayor: a town has one of, at the head of its council
offices.bailiff: a town has one of, to keep its lord's peace and rents
offices.constable: a town has one of, to keep its watch
offices.harbourmaster: a harbour has one of, to keep its berths and dues
offices.sheriff: a shire has one of, and a town at most one
